mayhem.summaryZh: 26.14 主要下调高挫败感海克斯、加强弱势选项，并调整海克斯随机机制，减少同类选项反复出现。飞身踢仍保留高上限，但其生命值收益被大幅压低；维度偏移、魄罗奔袭和软泥拍抓等偏弱选择获得明显加强。
mayhem.summaryEn: Patch 26.14 lowers several high-frustration Augments, buffs struggling options, and adjusts Augment RNG to reduce repetitive offers. Dropkick keeps its high-roll potential with far less health scaling, while Dimension Shift, Poro Stampede, and Squishy Slappy Grab receive meaningful buffs.

augmentChanges.name: 维度偏移
augmentChanges.changeEn: Cooldown: 108s → 75s. AD/AP: 25–100 → 35–150. Health: 200–1000 → 300–1500. New: deals 1 damage to structures.

augmentChanges.name: 软泥拍抓
augmentChanges.change: 每个被拍目标提供的护盾：25–75 → 35–150。

augmentChanges.name: 针插垫
augmentChanges.change: 新增斩杀：累计伤害足以击杀目标时会直接斩杀。
augmentChanges.changeEn: New execute: executes when accumulated damage would kill the target.

augmentChanges.name: 飞身踢
augmentChanges.changeEn: Base value: 5% → 4%. Base AD scaling: 0.035% → 0.055%. Bonus-health scaling: 0.002% → 0.0001%.

augmentChanges.name: 炼狱导管
augmentChanges.change: 不再会因影响非英雄单位而减少冷却时间。
augmentChanges.changeEn: No longer reduces cooldown when affecting non-champions.

augmentChanges.name: 叠角龙
augmentChanges.change: 不再影响海克斯或装备效果。
augmentChanges.changeEn: No longer affects Augment or item effects.

bugfixes: 修复「神圣领域」可无限增加攻击距离的问题。
修复「燃财效应」不会为德莱厄斯、提莫、图奇等持续伤害提供金币的问题。
修复斯莫德可能获得「燃财效应」的问题。
修复「该出发了」未能正确给予剑圣 E、艾希 Q、图奇 Q 额外移速的问题。
修复「高玩」有时不会在单位死亡时掉落铁砧的问题。
修复「掉落熊」有时会在生成后立刻死亡的问题。
修复选择「鲨鱼风暴」和「雪球炸弹」后仍可能获得另一个主动召唤师技能的问题。
修复「急速追猎」可能被分配给亚索 E 的问题。
bugfixesEn: Fixed Divine Domain granting infinite attack range.
Fixed Combusting Interest not granting gold from damage-over-time effects such as Darius, Teemo, and Twitch.
Fixed Smolder being offered Combusting Interest.
Fixed It's Go Time not correctly granting move speed with Master Yi E, Ashe Q, and Twitch Q.
Fixed High Roller sometimes failing to drop an Anvil when a unit died.
Fixed Drop Bear sometimes dying immediately after spawning.
Fixed players still receiving another active summoner spell after choosing Shark Tempest and SnowBomb.
Fixed Pursuit of Haste being offered to Yasuo E.
